extraction.Name: Amelia Eva Huston
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 9, 1918 by the Volz Abstract Company
extraction.Buyer: Conveyed by deed signed by Amelia Eva Huston Nichols and George Nichols to C. E. Plummer for a consideration of $4,000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612726 issued; Southwest quarter of section 3, township 98, range 79; receipt for patent signed by the allottee January 30, 1918; conveyance dated October 12, 1918; allottee also identified as Amelia Eva Huston Nichols (married name)
